name: Next.js 16
detail: App Router serves the storefront, ERP screens and API routes.

name: React 19
detail: Catalog filters, account tabs, gallery zoom and cart state use React.

name: TypeScript
detail: Typed components and routes connect the browsing and operational workflows.

name: Bootstrap 5
detail: The source uses Bootstrap and custom CSS for responsive storefront and ERP layouts.

name: Prisma 5
detail: Prisma models the data and groups related operational writes into database transactions.

name: PostgreSQL
detail: Stores products, quotes, users, ledger accounts, sales, purchases and chat history.

name: NextAuth
detail: Credentials-based sign-in uses JWT sessions with a user ID and role.

name: React context
detail: Guest and per-user cart drafts persist in localStorage. Bulk pricing changes at quantity ten.

name: jsPDF
detail: jsPDF and AutoTable generate PDF invoice documents in the administration code.

name: SheetJS / XLSX
detail: The administrator bulk-import route reads CSV or spreadsheet rows and maps product fields.

name: Nodemailer
detail: The invoice-send route accepts a PDF payload and uses environment-configured SMTP.

name: Gemini
detail: The source sends business-context prompts and stored conversation history to a configured Gemini model. Chat generation was not exercised in this walkthrough.

name: Recharts
detail: Retailer detail screens use charts to present activity and account statistics.
